meta.note: Nathan: 'We created an archive, which is our storage node.' The Archive IS the storage node.

right: The five regulatory primitives (can_act/update_state/apply_rule/emit_signal/self_repair) are a clean, implementable governance API.
The sense->regulate->act->record->adjust tick gives per-agent homeostasis.
Storage partitions (state log, regulatory ledger, signal history, identity) are a sound schema.
wrong: 'Living organism, not a config file' is costume — a JSON schema per agent is still structured state; the name doesn't change the substance.
'Without a single global cop' conflicts with the architecture — the Brain maintainers + Mira's Gate ARE the global layer. Correct model: local homeostasis + global Brain, not either/or.

primitives: can_act() -> allowed/delayed/denied (energy, error rate, cooldowns, global load)
apply_rule(rule_id, context) -> physics + policy (rate limits, mutation caps, allowed partners)
emit_signal(kind, payload) -> signal history, may trigger global regulators
self_repair() -> revert to last stable, disable bad organelle, escalate

real_machinery.homeostasis: Stable fixed point / limit cycle. Feedback u = -K(x - x*). Lyapunov V with Vdot <= 0 as the stability proof.
real_machinery.resonance: Kuramoto: theta_dot_i = omega_i + (K/N) sum sin(theta_j - theta_i). Entrainment is the resonance math, equation-level.
real_machinery.exploration: Boltzmann/softmax policy pi(a) ~ exp(-E(a)/T). Temperature T is the exploration knob, annealed on the adjust tick.
real_machinery.selection: Replicator equation xdot_i = x_i (f_i - fbar). The rarity economy's real formula.
real_machinery.error_detection: Quantum-error-correction pattern: syndrome measurement detects errors without collapsing state -> checksums / invariant watchdogs.
real_machinery.source: Nonlinear dynamics, statistical mechanics, thermodynamics (nonequilibrium steady state). Per 2026-10-14 physics research.

calculus.lyapunov: V > 0, Vdot = grad V . f <= 0 (strict < 0 => asymptotic; radial unboundedness => global). Linear case: V = x^T P x with A^T P + P A < 0.
calculus.kuramoto_mean_field: Coherence order parameter r e^{i psi} = (1/N) sum e^{i theta_j}; mean-field form d theta_i/dt = omega_i + K r sin(psi - theta_i). Critical coupling needs mean-field/bifurcation theory beyond the ODEs.
calculus.source: 2026-10-14 calculus research (Wikipedia: Calculus; Kuramoto model; Lyapunov stability).

information_theory.budget: 15 MB = 125,829,120 bits. The Archive is literally a rate-distortion problem: minimize D s.t. rate <= budget. Keep items by delta-D/delta-bits; discard items with H(item|Archive) ~= 0.
information_theory.best_parts: Lossy compression bounded below by R(D) = min_{E[d]<=D} I(U;Uhat).
information_theory.signals: Signal histories are channels auditable via capacity C. Use DIRECTED information I(X^n -> Y^n) = sum_i I(X^i; Y_i | Y^{i-1}) — not mutual information — for who-influenced-whom in conversational feedback.
information_theory.rarity: Selection maximizes I(kept; future utility), not raw entropy. Consolidation keeps sufficient statistics. MDL for tier design.
information_theory.deliberation: Distributed source coding: shared context is free side information; store innovations only. H(final|initials) ~= 0 for rejected challenges — they cost nothing to forget.
honest_limits: Stationarity/ergodicity fail — use information-spectrum methods and sliding windows; drift costs D_KL(p_new||p_old).
Bits are syntactic: the distortion function d must come from task utility.
KL is asymmetric; empirical MI estimators are biased; source-channel separation fails for multi-agent networks.
